M8.positives: all ComCat events typed landslide, mine collapse or collapse in the window (labels hidden for classification)

M8.neighbourhood: ComCat global M>=4.5 catalogue, window +-0.5 yr; 30 km / +-400 d neighbourhood for positives
M8.primary_endpoint: false-positive rate on negatives, mode catalogue_only

secondary_endpoints: recall per class on positives (both modes), Clopper-Pearson 95% CI, descriptive (expected n ~5-8 per year)
sensitivity: control exclusion 50 km instead of 25 km around case centres
M8.reporting: result reported regardless of outcome; no re-tuning of thresholds
